notes.title: 1 Week to Release. Thank you everybody.
notes.notes:
Dear Fiends,

We're excited to announce that "Vorax" is just one week away from releasing in Early Access on[b] July 18th.[/b]
 To celebrate this milestone, we released a new teaser trailer that encapsulates the essence of the game.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lMSHbFGU1L4

The journey to this point has been one of relentless effort, passion and dedication. Over the past three years, our team has poured blood, sweat, and tears into finding the perfect balance between survival and horror mechanics. We hope we have succeeded, we will submit to your judgment and we will always try to improve during Early Access.
Furthermore, from an artistic point of view we have always followed our vision and are immensely proud of the monster designs, and we sincerely hope that players enjoy all of these elements as much as we do.

[h1]Early Access and Beyond[/h1]
As we embark on this early access journey, we are committed to continually updating and improving "Vorax." Our goal is to add tons of new content over the next year, with the aim of crafting the best survival horror experience out there. Your feedback will be invaluable in shaping the future of the game, and we look forward to evolving and enhancing the world of "Vorax" together with our community.

[b]We would never have made this release without the support of our community and all Indiegala users that loved our website and our games.
Thanks to everyone who supported us and will support us. Thank you on behalf of the entire Indiegala team.[/b]

Stay vigilant and prepare for the horrors that await. Watch the teaser trailer now and get ready to dive into "Vorax" on July 18th.

notes.title: SuperTotalCarnage! Online Multiplayer Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42859851/0f59b1a4d24ea5d500b800f23e007b5837f5fcb0.png[/img]
Get ready for a treat as the newest update for [b]SuperTotalCarnage![/b] is finally here. After facing unexpected hurdles that forced us to halt updates, we are now back with a vengeance, bringing an exhilarating online multiplayer feature to the game.

In December, we faced some problems that abruptly halted our progress and left our dedicated community in the dark. We are unable to delve into the specifics of the issue, but we want to express our sincere apologies to players for the sudden interruption and lack of communication during this challenging time.

Despite the hardships, our commitment to the game and its community never wavered. Now, we are thrilled to announce the release of our most significant update to date. The addition of online multiplayer brings a whole new level of excitement and competition to the action-packed world of SuperTotalCarnage!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42859851/48b941b5fcfcee79c6807d3f1ed63f4d516f7fcf.png[/img]

The [b]Online Multiplayer[/b] mode allows players to engage in thrilling [b]PVP battles[/b]. Choosing their favorite hero, players will embark on a standard level, where each monster slain by a player will be transferred to their opponent's stage. The objective is simple: overpower the enemy with an onslaught of monsters and emerge victorious. This exciting new feature promises adrenaline-pumping matches filled with strategic gameplay and intense action.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42859851/c598df03f02970df4c30cecbec0f160582d0b1c4.png[/img]

While the update is still in its early stages, we acknowledge that a few issues may arise. However, we are eager for players to experience the new mode firsthand and provide valuable feedback. By actively engaging with the community we aim to refine and enhance the online multiplayer feature based on player suggestions and bug reports.

Prepare for an adrenaline-fueled battle like never before, as [b]SuperTotalCarnage![/b] returns to reclaim its place among the gaming elite. Join the fight, test your skills, and help shape the future of this remarkable game. The action begins now!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42859851/a4e0e2feb45dec75a0a4cc49497c70aeee5f9543.png[/img]
You might also want to try playing with your friends during this weekend, since they may try it out for FREE (including the new Online Feature) by grabbing it from IndieGala (from the site or client, and yes, you will be able to play together. [url=https://supertotalcarnage.indiegala.com/supertotalcarnage]Click here to visit the page and claim the game.[/url]

notes.title: Version 0.1.0.8 is LIVE + multiplayer mode coming soon!
notes.notes:
Hello boys and girls! ;-)

We are working every day to make the game better for you!
In this version there are a number of improvements on controller support, a new playable character (Zora) with her own weapon and a new super weapon!

There are also three new steam achievements and many small bugfixes!

I also wanted to officially announce that we are working on a fascinating multiplayer version! I still can't give you too many details because this mode is in the planning phase ( it won't be a co-op! ;-)) but I promise you that you will have news very soon!

Changelog v. 0.1.0.8:
- Added a new playable hero: Zora!
- Added a new weapon: Topi del Cielo
- Added a new super weapon: Pantegane del Cielo
- Added the option to confirm buttons with Space
- Select UI elements with the left analog stick
- Scrollable items with the right analog stick
- Fixed destructible standing objects not spawning in some cases
- Updated graphics for the SPATA

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42859851/bd7d2464ea07ed4ed1bca06c3a8174817a5403c9.jpg[/img]

Thank you all!

notes.title: Patch 0.1.0.4
notes.notes:
[h1]SuperTotalCarnage! PATCH 0.1.0.4 [/h1]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2118580/SuperTotalCarnage/][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/3402923/02b3a50aba304c735f2bff689ea7c9215043d6cf.jpg[/img][/url]

Here we are! 
We hope we started our EA journey with the right foot!
We released few hours ago indeed ... ;-) But took the time to work on the first suggestions we received from you!
So we ship you [h1]patch 0.1.0.4[/h1] with the following:

[list]
[*]  Changed Machingeun and Shotgun so they shoot in direction of the nearest enemy
This is one of the biggest changes you asked, because many of you correctly pointed out that starting weapons can be a bit frustrating how they are. We think this is a significant improvement on the gunplay overall but of course we are always available to improve it further!

[*] Added Fullscreen/Windowes option in Setting Menu
[*] Added Quit button in Title Screen
[*] Added Settings Menu in Title Screen
[*] Added Volume and Sfx slider
[*] Added rebindable controls
[/list]
